correctness.rationale: Affine normalization makes the five-point smallest-enclosing-circle minimax exact. The triple (indices 1,3,4) supplies a global lower bound: its squared circumradius is a positive constant times a strictly concave cubic in y=cos(2delta), and its obtuse region is handled separately through the decreasing longest-side half-length. Both endpoint disks have explicit centers, exact boundary contact identities and contact-convex-hull certificates. An exact factorization yields one transition; strict concavity excludes all intermediate optimizers. The area-ratio derivative is strictly positive on both branches. SymPy identities and 3,077 independently enumerated minimum-enclosing-circle examples agree; finite computations are only corroborative.
